verdict.rationale: Make is a workflow automation platform, so automatic retries with backoff for failed steps is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only mentions error handlers in general terms and never documents configurable automatic retries, retry counts, or backoff intervals. A generic reference to error handlers is an adjacent feature, not the retry-with-backoff capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities
